name: com.alltegrio/site
title: Alltegrio
description: Search and read alltegrio.com (AI development company); send Alltegrio a project inquiry.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the website of Alltegrio, a custom AI development company: services (AI agents, generative AI, LLM and RAG systems, machine learning, computer vision, data engineering, MLOps), industry pages, case studies, blog articles and glossary terms. Use it to find what Alltegrio offers, has built or has written about. Returns matching pages with snippets and URLs; read one in full with fetch, passing its id.

query.description: Free-text search query in English, e.g. "AI agents for insurance claims".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text of one alltegrio.com page as markdown, by the id from search results (its canonical URL).

id.description: Page id from search: its canonical URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one alltegrio.com page by its canonical URL (e.g. https://alltegrio.com/cases/ai-data-analyst-in-microsoft-teams). The same as fetch, as plain text.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a project inquiry to Alltegrio on the user’s behalf: a request for a consultation, an estimate or a proposal for AI or software development. It reaches the Alltegrio team’s inbox and they reply by email to the address given. Use it only when the user asked to contact Alltegrio, with the user’s own name and email address — never invent them — and show the user the text before sending. Sending means the user agrees to the Privacy Policy: https://alltegrio.com/privacy-policy/

email.description: The user’s real email address. Alltegrio replies to it.

message.description: What the user needs: the task, the business context, timing, any constraints.
